mapper.select: SELECT id, client_id, user_id, first_name, last_name, team_code, department_code, role_code, image_url, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, delete_flag FROM employee WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

SELECT id, client_id, user_id, first_name, last_name, team_code, department_code, role_code, image_url, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, delete_flag FROM employee WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}

SELECT id, client_id, user_id, first_name, last_name, team_code, department_code, role_code, image_url, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, delete_flag FROM employee WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (client_id, user_id, first_name, last_name, team_code, department_code, role_code, image_url, salary) VALUES (#{request.clientId}, #{request.userId}, #{request.firstName}, #{request.lastName}, #{request.teamCode}, #{request.departmentCode}, #{request.roleCode}, #{request.imageUrl}, #{request.salary})
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET first_name = #{request.firstName}, last_name = #{request.lastName}, team_code = #{request.teamCode}, department_code = #{request.departmentCode}, role_code = #{request.roleCode}, image_url = #{request.imageUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE client_id = #{request.clientId} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}
